people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
translations.bsb: “What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?” “David’s,” they answered.
translations.kjv: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
